population: existing island subset of 155 eligible species; 225 candidates retained in original disposition
model: species-by-landmass fixed effects weighted least squares, species equal total weight
exposure: log1p(distance to 2019 port), interaction with introduced_share centered at .5
controls: log1p prior and subsequent recording days
baseline temperature and precipitation plus temporal trends
baseline cropland,built,tree cover plus temporal trends
inference: two-way species and 5-degree spatial-block cluster covariance; few-island limits retained; no causal mediation or transport inference
host_scale: species-region static introduced host proportion, not local plants
fixed_effect_elimination: weighted within species-landmass centering; drop zero-variation columns; report rank/condition
primary_association: log port distance x introduced host proportion
